answer: Every tent peg is stamped with its maker's mark and filed with the caravan guild, and only a stamped peg may hold a tent in the storm. A jetty peg carved at home fails the mark: at the hollow of the peg the stamp must match the guild's own die, and a home peg is stamped crooked. Forging the mark means bribing a guild master, carving 600 pegs and paying 6,500, while the shale file in the guild chest is read at every camp, so a peg whose mark was never filed is pulled from the ground.
